newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech finance, interior ministers resign.
newsitem.headline: Czech finance, interior ministers resign.

text.p: PRAGUE, May 24 (REUTER) - Czech finance and interior ministers Ivan Kocarnik and Jan Ruml have resigned from their posts, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus told a news conference broadcast live by Czech Radio on Saturday.

Klaus said the ministers, both members of his Civic Democratic Party (ODS), would be replaced by economist Jiri Waigel, his chief adviser who is not affiliated to any party, and Petr Necas, an ODS deputy and chairman of the lower house defence and security committee.
Under the terms of the agreement signed by the three-party ruling coalition, each member is able to change its own ministers without consulting the others.

Klaus also said the ODS would welcome it if Michael Zantovsky, leader of junior coalition partner the Civic Democratic Alliance, took a cabinet post. He has been tipped for Defence, held by the Christian Democrats, or Foreign Affairs, held by the ODS.
"If the ODS could contribute to this by passing one of its portfolios into an exchange (of ministries between coalition parties), I can say the ODS is prepared to do so," Klaus said.
He added that there had been no talk of Foreign Minister Josef Zieleniec leaving the government during the meeting of the ODS leadership.
